store.description: Pfadfinder logs Wi-Fi and Bluetooth networks with GPS while you drive or walk, aircraft with an RTL-SDR, and the mesh nodes a Meshtastic or MeshCore device on USB hears. It keeps running with the screen off to save battery and uploads to WiGLE, WDGWars and Wardrift. USB Wi-Fi and Bluetooth dongles are used when plugged in; the internal radios are the fallback. GPS comes from a USB receiver, the Grove port or the Cap LoRa-1262.
